description: A short burst of highpassed white noise, in the manner of the 808 maraca

params.text: Sets how fast the burst fades, 2.5ms fully anticlockwise to 12.5ms fully clockwise; the tooltip and the manual say 2ms to 20ms
Fires the burst; a rising edge at the trigger jack does it too

inputs.text: A rising edge above 0.5V fires the sound; the length of the gate makes no difference

outputs.text: The noise burst, up to 5V peak

notes: a CV input is bipolar and is added to its knob: 10V there is worth the knob's whole travel, -10V cancels a knob that is fully up, and the total is clamped to the knob's own range
the highpass filter is fixed at 6000Hz with a Q of 1, and there is no control for it

inputs.0:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
high above 0.5V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
